issue.title: block-id-prompt task-wikilink picker runtime test passes 19/19 then never exits, hanging bob-plugins npm test
issue.description:
## What fails

Repo: bob-plugins (linked). `scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-wikilink-picker-runtime.cjs`
passes all 19 test cases, then its `node --test` file process never exits. Under
`--test-timeout` it is reported as one cancelled file-level `testTimeoutFailure`
(ERR_TEST_FAILURE). Without a timeout, `npm test` (whose `test:unit` stage lists this
file) never returns, so the full bob-plugins suite cannot complete as a gate.

## Reproduction (Node 22.14.0, athena)

    node --test --test-timeout=10000 scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-wikilink-picker-runtime.cjs
    # tests 20, pass 19, fail 0, cancelled 1

Reproduced identically on bob-plugins 99ccca1 (before the bank epic), d532aad, 70408bf,
9c79123, 564f3c1, and current master d2e4137, so it predates bob-cli-kd.6.1 and is
unrelated to the bank UI.

## Likely cause and fix direction

A lingering handle (an un-cleared real interval/timeout, or an un-closed listener)
created by the picker runtime under Node, where no `window` exists. A sibling case in the
same repo was fixed during the bob-cli-kd.6.1 landing: `241p-plugin-bank-marks.js`
created a 60 s `setInterval` through a `globalThis` fallback without the timer-host
guard the other bank timers use, which kept `test-ledger-tools-day-strip-plan-host.cjs`
alive. Find the handle here (e.g. `node --test` with `why-is-node-running`, or
`process._getActiveHandles()` at the end of the file) and either guard the timer behind
an injected/`window` timer host, `unref()` it, or tear the plugin down in the test's
`after` hook. Do not merely raise timeouts.

## Evidence

Proposed by bob-cli-kd.6.1.3 notes #4/#5 (6215-pass bounded full-suite diagnostic with
only this file timing out, evidence file:explicit:459723958199a494a5792a15) and
bob-cli-kd.6.1.5 note #4; re-reproduced by the bob-cli-kd.6.1 land agent.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: every run on six commits from 99ccca1 to d2e4137 passes 19 cases then times out at file level; it never exits on any run.

issue.creation_reason: Bank epic phases bob-cli-kd.6.1.3 and .5 proposed it after full npm test never returned; the kd.6.1 lander reproduced it on the pre-epic base, so it needs its own fix.
